title: Datatypes
description:
Now, time to get to the whole point of typescript: Datatypes. Typescript has 3 main datatypes: string, number, and boolean.
---
`string`: String stores a string of text, such as "Hello, World!"
`number`: Number stores a number. Decimal or whole, just a number.
`boolean`: Boolean stores true or false. Simple!
